brief.headline: Close the 326.9% gap to Silk Polypack's ₹250.00/KG by moving toward the ₹171.60/kg import benchmark — our ₹1067.36/KG is unsustainable.

priceAsk.summary: Target ₹250.00/KG for laminates, matching Silk Polypack's best price we currently pay
priceAsk.basis: We pay Huhtamaki ₹1067.36/KG — a 326.9% premium over the ₹250.00/KG best price from Silk Polypack. Even the BOPET film import benchmark sits at ₹171.60/kg, well below our current rate. The gap costs us ₹58850 annually on tiny volume.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Hold at 30 Days After Receipt — we're too small to extract better terms without a volume commitment

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki India is financially sound: ₹2611.64 Cr revenue, 5.2% net margin, 8.3% EBITDA margin, low 0.11x debt-to-equity, and a B (64/100) health score with no risk flags. They're growing fast at 22.5% per year. However, our ₹76850 spend is 0.00% of their revenue — we have zero standalone leverage. They can afford to walk. Our only credible pressure is competitive: UFLEX Ltd and Constantia Parikh are proven laminate converters who can second-source at scale, and the import benchmark shows the substrate cost is a fraction of what we're paying.

evidence.point: Our laminate price is 326.9% above the best price we pay elsewhere
This price gap costs us annually
BOPET film import benchmark is far below our price
We represent zero commercial leverage as a customer
Huhtamaki is growing rapidly and values new volume
They carry minimal debt and strong margins

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant at ₹16492.00 Cr revenue — both film substrate and conversion capability, can second-source laminates at scale (health: C 54/100)

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia's India converter focused on pharma blister and sachet laminates, strong second-source for our application (₹222.04 Cr revenue, health: D 31/100)

alternates.name: Amcor Flexibles India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Amcor's India arm specializing in high-end pharma laminates — premium but very reliable alternative

risks: At 0.00% of their revenue we can be dropped instantly — lead with competitive quotes from UFLEX or Constantia, not demands
The 326.9% gap suggests we may be buying a specialty grade or small-lot service that Silk Polypack cannot match — verify exact spec and MOQ before quoting the ₹250.00/KG benchmark
Huhtamaki's B health score and 22.5% growth mean they don't need distressed-customer pricing — frame the ask as a volume-for-value trade, not a bailout
If we push too hard without volume commitment, they may simply decline to quote next tender — bundle this negotiation with a 12-month volume pledge
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value Huhtamaki's quality, but at ₹1067.36/KG we're paying 326.9% over market — help us understand the gap to the ₹171.60/kg import line and Silk Polypack's ₹250.00/KG, and let's find a way to earn more of our volume.
